The drive vector u is generated digitally on the PC and converted into 32 analog drive voltages by a 32-channel, 16-bit digital-to-analog converter (DAC). These voltages drive the PM array, and the resulting phase-modulated optical signals propagate through the fixed photonic encoding core. After on-chip photodetection, the 17-channel analog encoded outputs z ∈ ℝ17 are digitized by an 18-bit analog-to-digital converter (ADC).
